summary: Walks two linked lists of scene-graph nodes and clears a scene-graph flag on every node. The first walk follows the node chain starting at this+0x100 via each node's +0x104 forward link, descending into each node's sub-node list (head at +0xEC) via its +0x4C forward links. The second walk follows the chain starting at this+0x108 via +0x4C forward links. Every visited node gets BitmaskClear(0, 32, 0) followed by SceneGraphFlagPropagation(0, 0x10000000, 0); the last propagation result is returned.

operations.description: First list walk: iterate from the list head at this+0x100, following each node's +0x104 forward link while non-null.
Inner sub-node walk: for each node from the first list, iterate from its sub-node list head at +0xEC, following each sub-node's +0x4C forward link while non-null.
Per inner sub-node: call BitmaskClear(0, 32, 0) to clear a 32-bit bitmask.
Per inner sub-node: call SceneGraphFlagPropagation(0, 0x10000000, 0) to clear scene-graph flag 0x10000000; its result is stored and eventually returned.
Second list walk: iterate from the list head at this+0x108, following each node's +0x4C forward link while non-null.
Per node in the second list: call BitmaskClear(0, 32, 0) to clear a 32-bit bitmask.
Per node in the second list: call SceneGraphFlagPropagation(0, 0x10000000, 0) to clear scene-graph flag 0x10000000; its result is stored.
Return the result of the last SceneGraphFlagPropagation call.

unresolved: Node and sub-node object types are unnamed; this+0x100 and this+0x108 are treated as list heads on a container whose identity is unknown.
Semantics of the cleared flag 0x10000000 and the constants passed to BitmaskClear are not established.
